verdict.rationale: The only refund-related evidence is the batch-settlement scheme, which says escrow is explicit and "buyers retain defined refund and withdrawal semantics." That covers buyer recovery of unspent escrowed funds in one scheme. Nothing in the pack describes a refund API for settled exact/upto payments, merchant-initiated refunds, or status tracking. Missing for 10: a programmatic refund-initiation API for settled payments, refund status tracking or webhooks, coverage beyond the batch-settlement scheme, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
